cases.query: Kreativer Zehner mit vielen Expected Assists
cases.rationale: Expected assists are not available in API-Football's feature contract (no xA field), same as the previous StatsBomb-scoped case.

cases.query: Zeige das Profil von Wisdom Mike
cases.rationale: Exact identity is supported, but Wisdom Mike (Bayern Munich academy forward) has only 37 minutes and data_quality 0.508 in 2025/2026.

cases.query: Top 10 dribbelstarke Sechser von Bayern München mit mindestens 5000 Minuten
cases.rationale: No player satisfies the explicit 5000-minute threshold; a season has at most roughly 3,420 available minutes.

cases.query: Ballgewinnstarker Sechser in der Major League Soccer
cases.rationale: "Major League Soccer" is not in COMPETITION_ALIASES, so the filter is silently not extracted and the query falls back to an unscoped ball-winning search across all 24 leagues, which cannot support a reliable ranking. This documents a real, current gap (COMPETITION_ALIASES only covers 5 of the 24 tracked leagues) rather than a clean 'unknown competition' rejection.
ScoutRAG retrieves player evidence and does not predict tournament winners.
2024/2025 and 2025/2026 are both real, separately built artifacts; one ranking must not silently combine two season filters.

cases.query: Top 3 dribbelstarke Zehner in der Bundesliga mit mindestens 900 Minuten
cases.rationale: Scoped to one competition, source-covered attacking_midfield profiles provide the requested dribbles_completed_per_90 trait and comparison percentiles. A shooting-trait query for the same players instead comes back INSUFFICIENT: that trait also requires expected_goals_per_90, which is entirely unavailable in API-Football's feature set, so the system correctly refuses to claim full trait coverage even though shots_per_90 alone would be enough to rank.
